A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]-affiliated '''base''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spefik]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was defended by anti-orbital ion cannons, but these were insufficient to protect the base from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces that [[Battle of Spefik|attacked]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
